worker_claim.summary: Added topology-aware lifecycle recovery for published control descendants, including the case where a prior replay fast-forwarded local control before lifecycle validation failed. Recovery now proves the admitted-to-candidate ancestry and active-ticket identity, fast-forwards published intermediate descendants safely, and retains exact unpublished lifecycle proof for local-only histories. Added a regression covering retry after a post-fast-forward lifecycle failure.
